units.source_text: 源氏公子也在考虑：

en.t: Prince Genji was also thinking:

units.source_text: “这女子对我装作如此信任，使我掉以轻心，

en.t: This woman pretends to trust me so completely that she makes me let down my guard,

units.source_text: 有朝一日乘我不防，悄悄地逃走了，

en.t: and one day, taking advantage of my carelessness, she may quietly run away,

units.source_text: 教我到哪里去找寻她呢？

en.t: where would I ever go to find her?

units.source_text: 况且这里原是暂住的，

en.t: Besides, this place was only meant as a temporary lodging,

units.source_text: 哪一天迁居别处，也不得而知。”

en.t: and no one knows when she may move somewhere else.

units.source_text: 万一找不到她的去处，倘能就此断念，看作一场春梦，原是妥善之事。

en.t: If he could not find where she had gone, and could simply give her up as a spring dream, that would indeed have been the wisest course.

units.source_text: 可是源氏公子决不肯就此罢休。

en.t: But Prince Genji absolutely refused to leave the matter there.

units.source_text: 有时顾虑人目，不便前去幽会，

en.t: At times, because he feared the eyes of others, it was inconvenient for him to go to their secret meetings,

units.source_text: 孤衾独寝之夜，他总是提心吊胆，忧虑万状，痛苦不堪，生怕这女子在这夜间逃走了。

en.t: and on nights when he slept alone, he was always anxious, tormented by countless worries, afraid that she might run away that very night.

units.source_text: 于是他想：

en.t: So he thought:

units.source_text: “一不做，二不休，

en.t: Having gone this far, I may as well see it through,

units.source_text: 我还是不说她是何人，将她迎回二条院吧。

en.t: and bring her back to Nijo-in without saying who she is.

units.source_text: 如果世人得知，引起物议，这也是命定之事，无可奈何。

en.t: If the world finds out and gossip arises, that too is fate, and there is nothing to be done.

units.source_text: 虽说此事取决于我，但我对人从不曾如此牵挂，

en.t: Though the matter is in my own hands, I have never been so deeply attached to anyone before,

units.source_text: 今番真个是宿世姻缘了。”

en.t: so this must truly be a bond from a former life.

units.source_text: 他便对夕颜说：

en.t: He then said to Yugao:

units.source_text: “我想带你到一个地方去，

en.t: I want to take you somewhere,

units.source_text: 那里比这里舒服得多，我们可以从容谈心。”

en.t: a place much more comfortable than this, where we can talk together at ease.

units.source_text: 夕颜道：

en.t: Yugao replied:

units.source_text: “您虽这么说，但您的行径古怪，我有些害怕呢。”

en.t: You may say that, but your behavior is strange, and I am a little afraid.

units.source_text: 她的语调天真烂漫，

en.t: Her tone was utterly innocent,

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：

en.t: and Prince Genji thought:

units.source_text: “倒也说得有理。”

en.t: She does have a point.

units.source_text: 便微笑着说：

en.t: Then he smiled and said:

units.source_text: “你我两人中，总有一个是狐狸精。

en.t: Between the two of us, one of us must be a fox spirit.

units.source_text: 你就当我是狐狸精，让我迷一下吧。”

en.t: Take me for the fox spirit, then, and let me enchant you a little.

units.source_text: 说得多么亲昵！

en.t: How intimate his words sounded!

units.source_text: 于是夕颜放心了，觉得不妨跟他去。

en.t: So Yugao felt reassured and decided that it would be all right to go with him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子认为这虽然是世间少有的乖戾行为，

en.t: Prince Genji thought that although this was an extraordinarily rash act,

units.source_text: 但这女子死心塌地地服从我，这点心确是可怜可爱的。

en.t: this woman's wholehearted obedience to him was truly pitiable and endearing.

units.source_text: 他总怀疑她是头中将所说的常夏，

en.t: He kept suspecting that she was the Tokonatsu whom To no Chujo had mentioned,

units.source_text: 便回想起当时头中将所描述的这女人的性情来。

en.t: and he recalled the character of that woman as To no Chujo had described her at the time.

units.source_text: 但他认为她自有隐瞒自己身份的理由，所以并不寻根究底。

en.t: But he believed she must have her own reasons for hiding her identity, so he did not press her for the truth.

units.source_text: 他看这女子的模样，觉得并无突然逃隐的意向。

en.t: From the way she seemed, he felt she had no intention of suddenly fleeing and hiding herself.

units.source_text: 倘疏远了她，也许她会变心；

en.t: If he kept his distance from her, perhaps her feelings would change;

units.source_text: 如今则可以放心。

en.t: but now he could feel at ease.

units.source_text: 于是他想象：

en.t: Then he imagined:

units.source_text: “如果我略微把心移向别的女子，

en.t: If I were to turn my heart even slightly toward another woman,

units.source_text: 看她怎么样，倒是很有趣味的呢。”

en.t: it would be rather interesting to see what she would do.
